requirements.name: material-preview-surface
requirements.message:
UsdPreviewSurface inputs must use the types and token values the specification declares.This requirement is implemented by `usd-validation-nvidia`, which registers it as
`com.nvidia.usd.VM.PS.001` and binds it to `MaterialUsdPreviewSurfaceChecker`. A feature manifest references that
code. The unprefixed code is not bound to a rule in this repository.

examples.name: an input outside the specification, and a colour space outside the allowed tokens
an input of the wrong type, and a token carrying time samples

snippet.content:
def Material "mtl_cube"
{
    token outputs:surface.connect = </mtl_cube/PreviewSurfaceTexture.outputs:surface>

    def Shader "PreviewSurfaceTexture"
    {
        uniform token info:id = "UsdPreviewSurface"
        float inputs:clearcoat = 0
        float inputs:clearcoatRoughness = 0
        color3f inputs:diffuseColor.connect = </mtl_cube/diffuseColorTex.outputs:rgb>
        float inputs:displacement = 0
        token outputs:surface
    }

    def Shader "diffuseColorTex"
    {
        uniform token info:id = "UsdUVTexture"
        asset inputs:file = @./textures/color.png@
        uniform token inputs:sourceColorSpace = "auto"
        uniform token inputs:wrapS = "useMetadata"
        uniform token inputs:wrapT = "useMetadata"
        float3 outputs:rgb
    }
}

requirements.name: material-texture-maxsize
requirements.message: Texture dimensions must not exceed 16,384 pixels on either axis.

snippet.content:
def Material "opaque__metal__bracket"
{
    token outputs:mdl:surface.connect = </opaque__metal__bracket/Shader.outputs:out>

    def Shader "Shader"
    {
        uniform token info:implementationSource = "sourceAsset"
        uniform asset info:mdl:sourceAsset = @./materials/OmniPBR/OmniPBR.mdl@
        uniform token info:mdl:sourceAsset:subIdentifier = "OmniPBR"
        asset inputs:diffuse_texture = @./textures/bracket_basecolor.png@              # 8192x8192
        asset inputs:reflectionroughness_texture = @./textures/bracket_roughness.png@  # 4096x4096
        asset inputs:normalmap_texture = @./textures/bracket_normal.png@               # 2048x2048
        token outputs:out
    }
}

requirements.message: Shader inputs must use the type their specification declares and hold a finite value.

examples.name: every input has its declared type and a finite value

snippet.content:
def Material "ValidMdl"
{
    token outputs:mdl:surface.connect = </ValidMdl/Shader.outputs:out>

    def Shader "Shader"
    {
        uniform token info:implementationSource = "sourceAsset"
        uniform asset info:mdl:sourceAsset = @./OmniPBR.mdl@
        uniform token info:mdl:sourceAsset:subIdentifier = "OmniPBR"
        asset inputs:diffuse_texture = @./textures/bracket_basecolor.png@
        float inputs:metallic_constant = 1.0
        float inputs:reflection_roughness_constant = 0.5
        token outputs:out
    }
}
